info.title: Bangkok Transit live arrivals
info.summary: One shared, read-only JSON document of live BTS train arrivals.
info.description: The document behind the live times on https://bangkok-transit.com. A background job refreshes it every few seconds from a public BTS arrivals feed and publishes it as a single file on Cloudflare's CDN, so every client reads the same cached copy. There is nothing to sign up for and no API key. Covers BTS Sukhumvit and BTS Silom stations only; the other rail lines have no live feed. Times are estimates from that feed, not a timetable. Poll no more often than every 15 seconds: the file only changes about every 10 seconds at the edge.
info.x-provided-as-is: Estimates from a third-party public arrivals feed; no warranty or timetable guarantee.

get.summary: Live arrivals for every BTS Sukhumvit and Silom station
get.description: Returns the whole document. Each station's reading carries its own `timestamp` (UTC, with no trailing Z). Treat a reading older than about 90 seconds as last-known and drop one older than 30 minutes. The `Date` and `Age` response headers (exposed to browsers) give the edge copy's age.

Cache-Control.description: Short edge cache (a few seconds) with stale-if-error.

Age.description: Seconds the edge copy has been cached.

arrivals.description: Latest reading per station, keyed by the station's code (for example `N8`, `CEN`).

total.description: How many stations have live arrivals at all.

complete.description: True once the latest full poll has landed and is current, or the source is known to be down.

next_service.description: When service next starts, if it is not running.

server_time.description: The source's clock when it answered.

timestamp.description: When this reading was taken: UTC, ISO 8601 with no trailing Z.

direction.description: Thai and English destination joined in one string.

direction_key.description: Code of the terminus station in this direction.

carried_from.description: Set when these trains come from an older reading because the newest listed none for this direction.

eta_minutes.description: Minutes until arrival, as reported by the source.

eta_precise.description: The same, with a fractional part.

UpstreamStatus.description: Health of the upstream arrivals feed, as the poller sees it.

PollReport.description: What the latest poll did. Diagnostics only.
